_note: The mobs, read by both editions. Things are named by their keys (see blockKey in index.html / DataKeys.cs). Times in seconds, distances in blocks.

_notes.MOBS: every mob, in the order they're spawned. type = its name in the game (its model and skins have the same name); health; speed (blocks a second); max = the most of it around at once (0: it has its own spawning, like the cow); drops = [[thing, fewest, most, chance]] dropped when it's killed (chance left out = always); growl = its voice (heard every so often and when hit); hostile = chases and attacks you (survival only), with damage (hearts' quarters a hit, or what a thrown Rock takes off), sight (how far it sees you) and reach (how close it hits from); dark = spawns anywhere dark (caves any time, open ground at night); night = only on open ground after dark; deep = only where it's pitch dark underground; burns = catches fire in daylight with nothing over its head; shamble = walks like a zombie; glow = lights itself up, so it shows at full brightness in the dark; curious = drawn to block sounds (within hearing) and torches (within lightRange); thrower = keeps between near and far and throws Rocks; snuffer = puts burning torches out; faint = never looks darker than this; scale = how much bigger than its model it's drawn; cow = a cow (see COW). grrangry is the night mob from before the Zombie: only one of the two is in the game, as ZOMBIE_READY (web) / ZombieReady (desktop) says
_notes.LAYER_BOOST: a mob from a deeper stone layer has this much more health and damage for each layer down (0.1 = 10%)
_notes.GLOOM_FADE: a Gloomling fades away (time) when someone holding a lit torch comes this close (range)
_notes.COW: cows: perChunk = breeding stops at this many in a chunk; crowdedAt = cows near (nearRange) that make it crowded; fatAt = Grain to get fat; fedMax = the most Grain that counts; happyMax = the most happiness (seconds); grazeHappy / grainHappy = happiness from grazing / Grain; grazeBelow = grazes when happiness is under this; grazeTime = how long grazing takes; mateCooldown, mateCost (happiness), calfTime (to grow up), calfGrainBoost (Grain takes this off), calfHealth; regrowMin / regrowMax = eaten grass grows back between these
